description: This file contains selectors and utility functions for onboarding steps, preferences, and UI state management in the Mattermost web application. It manages onboarding steps, user roles, preferences, and visibility logic for onboarding tasks and legacy steps.

methods.name: getFirstChannelName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the first channel from user preferences.

methods.name: getShowLaunchingWorkspace
methods.description: Returns whether the 'launching workspace' modal should be shown.

methods.name: isStepForUser
methods.description: Determines if a onboarding step is applicable for the current user based on roles.
